_schema: HANSET source collection rules & cadence registry (2026-10-23). Strict compliance: public/official sources and open APIs only; never bypass login walls, paywalls, or technical blocks; never scrape Naver; never copy venue photos.

compliance_policy.store_format: Facts, short evidence notes, check date, and canonical official URL only (never full-text copy)

sources.name: 서울시 목욕장업 인허가 정보 (Seoul Open Data Plaza OA-16146)
sources.method: Open dataset / API (discovery only; 3-day lag means営業 status alone never proves today's open status)
sources.allowed_terms: Public open government license (공공누리); discovery stage only

sources.name: Operator Official Facility Pages (Orakai, Ambassador Pullman, Novotel Gangnam, Banyan Tree, Fraser Place, Signiel, Hyatt, Sisu House)
sources.method: Direct HTTP GET of public official KR/EN facility pages (no block/login bypass; no photo downloads)
sources.allowed_terms: Publicly accessible official facility information pages; extract factual conditions only
sources.cadence: twice_weekly for top 10 exposed Seoul saunas; daily for temporary closure notices

sources.name: Large Spa & Hot Spring Official Guides (Termeden, Hurshimchung, Spa Haesurang)
sources.method: Direct HTTP GET of public official guide & notice pages
sources.allowed_terms: Publicly accessible official guide pages; facts only

sources.name: CrossFit Official Affiliate List, HYROX Korea Race Pages & Box Official Websites
sources.method: Direct HTTP GET of public official pages
sources.allowed_terms: Public official event/box pages; facts only
sources.cadence: twice_weekly (daily within 7 days of race start)

sources.name: PubMed E-utilities, Europe PMC REST API, Crossref Works API
